proposed.text: A 400 sqm R-1 residential lot has problem-stated PSO = 50%, ISA = 8%, and USA = 20%. Calculate MACA% (Maximum Allowable Construction Area).
proposed.rationale: PD 1096 IRR defines MACA as PSO + ISA and specifically excludes USA. Therefore MACA = 50% + 8% = 58%.
proposed.explanation: The proposed edit corrects MACA to Maximum Allowable Construction Area and anchors the calculation to the PD 1096 definition.
